interface.name: weston_capture_v1
interface.description: The global interface exposing Weston screenshooting functionality intended for single shots. This is a privileged interface.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Affects no other protocol objects in any way.

request.name: create

description.summary: create an object for capturing output images

request.description: Creates a weston_capture_source_v1 for the given wl_output. The object delivers suitable buffer parameters and exposes the capture function. If the source is unavailable, capture attempts fail gracefully. The framebuffer source copies the final framebuffer and is intended to capture the desktop area. The full_framebuffer source also includes borders. The blending source copies the intermediate blending buffer.

interface.name: weston_capture_source_v1
interface.description: An object representing image capture functionality for a single source. Initial events are sent only if the output exists and the source is available.

entry.name: sequence
entry.summary: capture requested again before previous retired

request.name: destroy
request.description: Cancels an ongoing capture, makes its buffer contents undefined, and destroys this object.

request.name: capture
request.description: Requests a repaint that executes the capture. On success, complete is emitted; incompatible buffers cause retry; other failures cause failed. The client must wait for one of those events before requesting another capture. The wl_buffer must refer to compositor-writable storage. A compositor must implement capture into wl_shm buffers; other buffer types may be unsupported.

event.name: format
event.description: Provides a pixel format supported by the capture source. The format modifier is linear. This initial event may repeat when formats change and is followed by format_done.

event.name: size
event.description: Provides required dimensions. wl_shm rows must be 4-byte aligned without additional padding.

event.name: retry

description.summary: retry image capture with a different buffer

event.description: The buffer was incompatible; the client has received updated parameters and should retry.

event.name: failed
event.description: Capture failed, possibly due to an unsupported buffer/source, removed output, or compositor policy.

event.name: formats_done
event.description: Sent after all formats have been sent.
